product.name: Reproducible and Safe AI
product.description: A platform that allows users to run, test, and optimize machine learning models at scale, providing benchmarking against other models and datasets.

product.name: Reproducible and Safe AI Platform
product.description: A platform that automates the running, testing, and optimization of machine learning models, focusing on scalability and benchmarking against other models and datasets.

product.name: AI Safety
product.description: A service aimed at improving model performance by identifying and addressing model failures.

product.name: Transparency
product.description: A feature that provides insights into model performance by comparing it with other models and datasets.

product.name: Optimize Cloud Spend
product.description: A service that deploys models efficiently to ensure cost-effectiveness by charging only for actual usage.

product.name: Benchmarking
product.description: A tool for evaluating models across various fields, currently available for selected categories like object detection.
